items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: The nights we'd be off, we'd be right over there jamming with him.

ctx.x: And we used to go down where he was playing every night.
The nights we'd be off, we'd be right over there jamming with him. You knew him here from New Orleans when he was there?
Yeah, I knew him from here. When he came down here.
